now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#9
now.text: Gideon Malick works alongside Alexander Pierce as one of the HYDRA leaders hidden inside S.H.I.E.L.D. He once hoped Pierce would share his faith in Hive, but found him too bloodthirsty.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow HYDRA leader in S.H.I.E.L.D., who finds Pierce too bloodthirsty.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow HYDRA leader Malick found too bloodthirsty to share his faith in Hive.

proposed.text: Gideon Malick, a fellow HYDRA leader, once hoped Alexander Pierce would share his faith in Hive, but found him too bloodthirsty.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow HYDRA leader, who finds Pierce too bloodthirsty.

changes.evidence: Connection kept (share_no_title): in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#9 'Closure' Malick tells Ward 'I thought it might be Pierce, but he was bloodthirsty', an off-screen tie stated on screen. But Malick was never hidden inside S.H.I.E.L.D. (he sat on the World Security Council, then advised the President), and no scene shows them working side by side, so 'hidden inside S.H.I.E.L.D.' and 'works alongside' go.

proposed.title: Captain America: Brave New World
proposed.text: Thaddeus Ross keeps trying to reach his estranged daughter. After he is locked in the Raft, Betty visits him and they begin to make peace.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Betty's father, who reaches out to her. She visits him in the Raft.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Ross's daughter, who visits him in the Raft to make peace.

changes.evidence: In Captain America: Brave New World Betty has stopped speaking to Ross; he calls her, she finally answers and agrees to a walk, and after he has himself locked in the Raft she visits him and they agree to sit and talk. A reconciliation after the last stage's estrangement.

proposed.title: Captain America: Civil War
proposed.text: As Crossbones, Rumlow fights Natasha in Lagos and tries to kill her by dropping a grenade into the armored truck she is trapped in.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An old foe Rumlow fights in Lagos and tries to kill with a grenade.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: As Crossbones, fights Natasha in Lagos and tries to kill her with a grenade.

changes.evidence: In Captain America: Civil War, in Lagos, Crossbones grabs Black Widow by the hair, fights her atop an armored truck and drops a grenade into the truck after trapping her inside; she tries to electrocute him and he says 'I don't work like that no more'.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: On the Time Heist, Steve steps into an elevator with the Rumlow of 2012 and fools him and Sitwell into handing over Loki's scepter with a whispered "Hail Hydra."
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fools a past Rumlow into handing over the scepter with a "Hail Hydra."
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A HYDRA agent of 2012, fooled into handing Steve the scepter.

changes.evidence: In Avengers: Endgame, the 2023 Steve enters the Stark Tower elevator with Rumlow, Sitwell and Rollins, claims Pierce sent him; Rumlow refuses until Steve whispers 'Hail Hydra', then Rumlow hands him the scepter.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Bruce and Natasha work together on the Time Heist. When she gives her life on Vormir, Bruce mourns her and tries to bring her back with the Stones, but cannot.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate lost on Vormir, whom Bruce tries and fails to bring back.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An old flame, who tries and fails to bring Natasha back with the Stones.

changes.evidence: In Avengers: Endgame, after Natasha's sacrifice on Vormir Bruce hurls a bench across the lake and says 'She's not coming back'; later he tells Steve 'When I had the gauntlet, the stones, I really tried to bring her back. I miss her, man.' A death after the last (romance) stage. Kind friend because the romance ended in Age of Ultron; owner may prefer to keep partner.

proposed.title: Ms. Marvel#6
proposed.text: Sadie Deever ignores Cleary's order to stand down and storms Coles Academic High School after Kamran and Ms. Marvel. Cleary relieves her of duty.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Damage Control agent who defies Cleary's orders, until he relieves her of duty.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Sadie's superior, who relieves her of duty for defying him.

changes.evidence: Outside the focus (No Way Home: Deever only watches Cleary's interrogations as an uncredited extra, nothing between them, so no earlier stage). Seen in passing: in Ms. Marvel#6 'No Normal' Deever defies Cleary's stand-down order at the school, and Cleary calls to relieve her of duty.
